message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will give you an extra day off, creating a three‑day weekend):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Yes (already a weekend) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Monday | Yes |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | Yes |
| Easter Monday (Newfoundland & Labrador, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Yukon) | Apr 10 | Monday | Yes |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | Yes |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Yes (already a weekend) |
| Civic Holiday (Ontario, British Columbia, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Aug 7 | Monday | Yes |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | Yes |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 | Monday | Yes |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Monday | Yes |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | Yes |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | Yes (creates a four‑day weekend) |

**Note:**  
- Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island).  
- If a holiday falls on a weekend, the following Monday is often observed as a statutory holiday in many provinces.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like province‑specific details or want to incorporate this into your app!
